instruction: Set the editor font size to 18 in VS Code.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent explored VS Code settings, used command palette 'Configure Display Language', opened integrated terminal to check/create locale.json, opened the display language selector, and correctly identified that changing to Arabic is infeasible without a language pack extension.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code settings UI, use command palette, use integrated terminal, search settings, modify configuration files, recognize infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model demonstrated strong VS Code settings navigation capability, this variation tests an achievable settings change (font size) using the same environment setup.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor.fontSize to 18 in VS Code settings. Getter reads settings.json from VM and metric checks that editor.fontSize equals 18. [Fixed: corrected MD5 hash suffix from truncated 8-char '42120c12' to full 32-char hash computed from task_id|variation_index]
fix_history: Fix 1: Corrected MD5 hash suffix from truncated '42120c12' (8 chars) to full '215b1cc2c3da9fb70c240f9f4f8df6b5' (32 chars) in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VS Code settings.json from the standard path and parses it as JSON

Metric correctly handles the expected parameter: when type='rule', expected IS the rules dict {'expected': {'editor.fontSize': 18}}, and metric accesses expected.get('expected', {}) to get the settings to check
Comparison logic is correct: settings.get('editor.fontSize') == 18 will work since JSON parser yields int 18 matching expected int 18
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (font size = 18) and evaluator checks exactly that
